name: SCAMPER Brainstorm
description: The whole class evolves each other's ideas through four creative lenses — swap, merge, repurpose, strip. At the end, your own idea comes back and you see everything four classmates did to it.

intro.message:
SCAMPER BRAINSTORM

Today's problem: lunch lines at school are painfully slow.

You'll write ONE idea to solve it. Then your idea travels — four classmates each reshape it through a different creative lens. At the end, your idea comes back and you see its whole journey.

initial-idea.prompt:
The problem: lunch lines at school are painfully slow.

Write ONE idea that could help. Don't polish it — just get something down. Four classmates are about to make it stranger and better.

returned.hostTemplate:
Everyone's original idea just came home — with its full journey through four classmates' hands.

Give the room a quiet minute to read. Then ask 2-3 students to read their idea's whole evolution aloud — the jumps are the fun part.

end.message: That's SCAMPER! Nobody's idea survived unchanged — that was the point. Edit the problem in the intro and first prompt to brainstorm anything.

recommendedFor: Project-based learning and innovation units. Swap the default problem (lunch lines) for your real one — it appears in the intro and the first prompt.
